adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: With a defined implementation date, 24 repeated observations before and after, and a preexisting trend, segmented interrupted time-series regression is the best nonrandomized analytic design.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: A simple pre/post mean comparison discards the baseline slope and can falsely attribute continuation of the secular trend to the intervention.
